WHERE id = ?\",\n\t\ts.Round, s.TurnIndex, s.ID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"DELETE FROM combat_conditions WHERE session_id = ?\",\n\t\ts.ID,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tfor target, conds := range s.Conditions {\n\t\tfor _, c := range conds {\n\t\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t\t\"INSERT INTO combat_conditions (session_id, target, condition, remaining_rounds) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n\t\t\t\ts.ID, target, c.Condition, c.Remaining,\n\t\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn tx.Commit()\n}\n\n// --- compendium DB helpers ---\n\nfunc dbCreateMonster(m *monster) error {\n\ttx, err := db.Begin()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tdefer tx.Rollback()\n\n\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\"INSERT INTO monsters (slug, name, cr, armor_class, hit_points) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n\t\tm.Slug, m.Name, m.CR, m.ArmorClass, m.HitPoints,\n\t); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, tag := range m.Tags {\n\t\tif _, err := tx.Exec(\n\t\t\t\"INSERT INTO monster_tags (monster_slug, tag) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n\t\t\tm.Slug, tag,\n\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn tx.Commit()\n}\n\nfunc dbGetMonster(slug string) (*monster, error) {\n\tm := &monster{Slug: slug}\n\terr := db.QueryRow(\n\t\t\"SELECT name, cr, armor_class, hit_points FROM monsters WHERE slug = ?\",\n\t\tslug,\n\t).Scan(&m.Name, &m.CR, &m.ArmorClass, &m.HitPoints)\n\tif err == sql.ErrNoRows {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\trows, err := db.Query(\n\t\t\"SELECT tag FROM monster_tags WHERE monster_slug = ? json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"invalid json\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tm := diceExpr.FindStringSubmatch(strings.TrimSpace(req.Expression))\n\tif m == nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"invalid expression\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tcount, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[1])\n\tsides, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[2])\n\tmodifier := 0\n\tif m[3] != \"\" {\n\t\tmodifier, _ =      max,\n\t\t\"average\":    average,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc abilityCheckHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tRoll     int `json:\"roll\"`\n\t\tModifier int http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tParty []struct {\n\t\t\tLevel int `json:\"level\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"party\"`\n\t\tMonsters []struct {\n\t\t\tCR    string `json:\"cr\"`\n\t\t\tCount int    `json:\"count\"`\n\t\t} `json:\"monsters\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"invalid json\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tbaseXP := 0\n\tmonsterCount := 0\n\tfor _, m := range req.Monsters {\n\t\txp, ok := crXP[m.CR]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tbadRequest(w, fmt.Sprintf(\"unsupported cr: %s\", m.Count\n\t}\n\n\tvar multiplier float64\n\tswitch {\n\tcase monsterCount == 1:\n\t\tmultiplier = 1\n\tcase monsterCount == 2:\n\t\tmultiplier = 1.5\n\tcase monsterCount >= 3 && monsterCount <= 6:\n\t\tmultiplier = 2\n\tcase monsterCount >= 7 && monsterCount <= 10:\n\t\tmultiplier = 2.5\n\tcase monsterCount >= 11 && monsterCount <= 14:\n\t\tmultiplier = 3\n\tcase monsterCount >= 15:\n\t\tmultiplier = 4\n\tdefault:\n\t\tmultiplier = 1\n\t}\n\n\tadjustedXP := float64(baseXP) * multiplier\n\n\ttotals := thresholds{}\n\tfor _, p := range req.Party {\n\t\tt, ok := levelThresholds[p.Level]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tbadRequest(w, fmt.Sprintf(\"unsupported party level: %d\", p.Level))\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotals.easy += t.easy\n\t\ttotals.medium += t.medium\n\t\ttotals.hard += t.hard\n\t\ttotals.deadly += t.deadly\n\t}\n\n\tadjusted := int(adjustedXP)\n\tdifficulty := \"trivial\"\n\tif adjusted >= totals.deadly {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"deadly\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.hard {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"hard\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.medium {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"medium\"\n\t} else if adjusted >= totals.easy {\n\t\tdifficulty = \"easy\"\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{\n\t\t\"base_xp\":       baseXP,\n\t\t\"monster_count\": monsterCount,\n\t\t\"multiplier\":    multiplier,\n\t\t\"adjusted_xp\":   adjustedXP,\n\t\t\"difficulty\":    difficulty,\n\t\t\"thresholds\": map[string]int{\n\t\t\t\"easy\":   totals.easy,\n\t\t\t\"medium\": totals.medium,\n\t\t\t\"hard\":   totals.hard,\n\t\t\t\"deadly\": totals.deadly,\n\t\t},\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc initiativeOrderHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct derivedStatsHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tLevel     int `json:\"level\"`\n\t\tAbilities struct {\n\t\t\tStr int `json:\"str\"`\n\t\t\tDex int armorClass,\n\t\t\"modifiers\":         modifiers,\n\t})\n}\n\n// --- auth helpers ---\n\nfunc hashPassword(password string) (string, error) {\n\tbytes, err := bcrypt.GenerateFromPassword([]byte(password), bcrypt.DefaultCost)\n\treturn string(bytes), err\n}\n\nfunc checkPassword(password, hash string) bool {\n\treturn bcrypt.CompareHashAndPassword([]byte(hash), []byte(password)) == nil\n}\n\nfunc registerHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tUsername string `json:\"username\"`\n\t\tPassword string `json:\"password\"`\n\t\tRole     string `json:\"role\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"invalid json\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif !usernameExpr.MatchString(req.Username) {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"username must be 2-32 lowercase letters, digits, _, or -\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif len(req.Password) < 8 {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"password must be at least 8 characters\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif req.Role != \"dm\" && req.Role != \"player\" {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"role must be dm or `json:\"username\"`\n\t\tPassword string `json:\"password\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tbadRequest(w, \"invalid json\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tusers.mu.RLock()\n\tdefer users.mu.RUnlock()\n\n\tu, exists := users.users[req.Username]\n\tif !exists || !checkPassword(req.Password, u.PasswordHash) {\n\t\tunauthorized(w, \"invalid credentials\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\twriteJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{\n\t\t\"username\": req.Username,\n\t\t\"token\":    \"session-\" + req.Username,\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc abilityModifier(score int) int {\n\tdiff := score - 10\n\tif diff < 0 {\n\t\treturn (diff - 1) / 2\n\t}\n\treturn diff / 2\n}\n\nfunc proficiencyBonus(level int) int {\n\tswitch {\n\tcase level >= 17:\n\t\treturn 6\n\tcase level >= 13:\n\t\treturn 5\n\tcase level >= 9:\n\t\treturn 4\n\tcase level >= 5:\n\t\treturn 3\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn 2\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc computeInitiative(combatants []combatantInput) []orderEntry {\n\tscored := make([]struct {\n\t\tname  string\n\t\tdex   int\n\t\tscore int\n\t}, len(combatants))\n\tfor i, c := range combatants {\n\t\tscored[i] = struct {\n\t\t\tname  string\n\t\t\tdex   int\n\t\t\tscore int\n\t\t}{name: c.Name, dex: c.Dex, score: c.Roll + c.Dex}\n\t}\n\n\tsort.Slice(scored, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif
